project.name: Redjack Corrupted Void Evolution
project.purpose: Reference-locked shader-evolution mockups for the Godot top-down space shooter enemy fleet.
project.audience: Game design and rendering review; readable at small gameplay scale.

style_lock.medium: Low-poly 3D spacecraft rendered through a pixel-locked Godot spatial shader.
style_lock.rendering: Crisp stepped/toon bands, near-black corrupted body planes, bright emissive reactor, restrained bloom, and nearest-neighbor low-resolution presentation.
style_lock.line_and_edge: Hard faceted edges with a dark inverted-hull separation band, palette-driven electric contour, and a one-sided violet/magenta fringe.
style_lock.shape_language: Compact, symmetrical, faceted enemy silhouettes with a pointed central fuselage, swept lateral wings, centered reactor, and small engine blocks.
palette: Current archetype energy color drives the shadow tint and primary glow.
Current archetype accent color drives fractures, reactor highlights, and most of the contour.
Corrupted void shadow: #17032E; violet fringe: #E609FF; deep space separation: #020309; reactor highlights may reach white-hot.
Do not make cyan/lime the dominant enemy identity; those colors belong to the player treatment.
style_lock.lighting: Top-down arcade key light with high contrast; the reactor and silhouette edge emit while the body stays materially dark.
style_lock.texture: Pixel dithering, sparse scanlines, discrete material bands, and fracture/circuit marks that increase with generation.
style_lock.composition: One centered front-facing enemy per square panel against a consistent deep navy starfield, generous margin, no HUD or explanatory text.
must_not_change: Preserve the Redjack outer silhouette, orientation, proportions, reactor placement, and engine-block placement across all four stages.
Preserve the current enemy palette roles; evolution changes shader intensity and complexity, not class identity.
Each stage must build on the previous stage with no abrupt model redesign or added geometry.
Keep the series readable at small gameplay size and distinct from the player's cyan/lime void silhouette.

style_profile.name: Corrupted Void Violet
style_profile.brief: A near-black, palette-tinted enemy silhouette with a bright reactor, hard stepped facets, one-sided violet fringe, and escalating corrupted fracture energy.
style_profile.application: Apply the corrupted-void material language to the same enemy identity at four sequential evolution stages. Preserve geometry and current archetype colors; add only the declared shader delta for each stage.
must_preserve: Pixel-locked edges and high-contrast reactor focus
Incremental evolution from the base treatment rather than four unrelated looks

style_reference_images.description: Approved corrupted-void violet enemy treatment from the earlier shader comparison.

identity_lock.silhouette: A single pointed triangular spacecraft with a long central fuselage, two broad swept side wings, and two short rectangular engine blocks at the bottom edge.
identity_lock.proportions: The central fuselage occupies roughly the middle half of the width and most of the height; the side wings extend symmetrically to either side; the reactor sits in the upper-middle third.
identity_lock.face_and_head: Not applicable; the centered faceted reactor is the focal feature and must remain centered on the fuselage.
identity_lock.surface_details: Low-poly faceted red hull panels, a faceted central reactor, dark engine blocks, and clean hard seams between the fuselage and wings.
palette: Redjack base energy: current red energy palette, approximately #FF0920.
Redjack accent: current pale red/pink accent palette, approximately #FF94AD.
The reactor may retain a hot amber-to-white center as an authored focal surface while the shader edge follows the current class palette.
identity_lock.personality_read: Hostile, direct, and disposable; the shader should make the enemy feel increasingly corrupted and dangerous without changing its silhouette.
must_not_change: Do not change the Redjack silhouette or orientation.
Do not move, resize, duplicate, or remove the central reactor.
Do not add weapons, antennae, fins, or other geometry.
Do not replace the current red class palette with the player's cyan/lime palette.

costume_lock.silhouette: No costume; the spacecraft hull and its shader treatment are the subject.

reference_images.description: Tight crop of the current Redjack Mk II model preview used as the fixed geometry reference; excludes presentation labels.
